releaseNotes:
• Continuous 30-Minute Screen-On Timer: Monotonic screen tracking; switching apps never resets the timer; screen-off resets session
• Pleasant Alert Sound: Harmonic synthesized chime and warm spoken prompt ('Please, sir! It\'s time to take care of yourself')
• Custom Audio & Video: Pick any song or video from device storage with persistent URI permissions and volume slider
• 3D Animations: High-fidelity animated walking character and drinking water glass Canvas visuals
• 3 Clear User Actions: 'Take a 5-Minute Break', 'Remind Me in 5 Minutes' (Snooze), and 'Dismiss'
• Synchronized Top Floating Timer: Displays live countdown (◷ 00:00 / 30:00) and break progress (☕ Break 05:00)
